integrity: Analytic proof provided; standalone exact-rational labeled-walk checker passed 704 CDF equalities, 160 odd parity equalities, 2564 strict even inequalities and 513 likelihood-ratio minors. No independent mathematical audit or external validation performed.
limitations: Uniform independent with-replacement d-offers with d>=2 on simple complete bipartite graphs; no heterogeneous offers, weighted neighbors or arbitrary graphs. Likelihood-ratio closure is a classical proof technique; specialized historical priority is qualified.
title: Optimal multi-offer cover walks: exact bipartite parity and start-side dominance
